name: SeasonTicketAccountManager
tagline: Season ticket renewals, seat map, relocations and payment plans for sports clubs – one drop-in Power Platform app.
description: A complete season ticket module for clubs and stadiums: renewal dashboard with deadline countdown, accounts list with bulk renewal actions, a block/row/seat map coloured by renewal status, relocation requests ranked by priority points, payment plans with instalment schedules, and ticket-exchange credit.
features: Renewal funnel and renewal % by price tier
Deadline countdown and at-risk holders by attendance
Allowed status transitions with business rules
Payment plans with deposit, instalment schedule and overdue detection
Relocation queue ranked by priority points with free-seat move
Bulk invite, renew, lapse, cancel and CSV export
Undo, demo mode, phone bottom navigation
